retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

limits.value: up to 20 concurrent sandboxes on Free, 1,000 on the paid tier

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not documented. email is the assumed default because priced hosts require an account; sign-up requirements are unconfirmed for this provider.
